summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the refinancing of a $300 million term debt securitization (CLO reset) of its indirect subsidiary, Palmer Square BDC CLO 1, Ltd. On July 15, 2026, the issuer issued $228 million of AAA Class A-R Notes at Term SOFR plus 1.28% and $72 million of AA Class B-R Notes at Term SOFR plus 1.75%, both due 2039. The company retains 100% of subordinated notes. BofA Securities acted as initial purchaser. This is a routine balance-sheet refinancing, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other transformative event is present.
